news.title: UI researchers reveal deeper workings of brain’s information hub
news.summary_en: A University of Iowa-led research team has shown in detail how a region of the brain called the frontoparietal cortex manages the flow of information and guides decisions and responses. The findings may inform future research into how this process is altered in neurological and psychiatric disorders.

news.title: Legacy built at Wendell Johnson Speech and Hearing Center continues
news.summary_en: The Wendell Johnson Speech and Hearing Center was the home of leading communication sciences and disorders work for more than 50 years.
